project_context: MOOD for DESIGN - Activity Feed & Timeline Redesign

design_philosophy.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Editorial Luxury
design_philosophy.theme: Light theme for content area, inside the existing #0A0A0B shell
design_philosophy.core_concept: The platform is an architectural blueprint, an editorial magazine, a professional notebook. It is NOT a dark-mode CRM. The interface must read like a curated story, eliminating technical metadata, chips, and database-like tables.
design_philosophy.shape_language: Sharp edges only. rounded-none everywhere. Borders are thin, structural lines (1px stone-200).

typography.h1_h2: Playfair Display (Serif) - Used for Person Names, Section Headers (e.g., 'Da completare'). Provides the 'Editorial/Magazine' feel.
typography.ui_body: Montserrat (Sans) - Used for activity subjects, outcomes, dates, and UI chrome. Clean, architectural, highly readable.
typography.hierarchy_rules: Persona (text-2xl/3xl Serif) > Argomento (text-lg medium Sans) > Esito/Prossimo Passo (text-base Sans) > Data (text-xs uppercase tracking-widest stone-400).

colors.rules: No generic grey. Use stone palette for warmth. Accent teal (#00C9B3) is used strictly for subtle indicators (e.g., a 2px left border on overdue tasks), NEVER for large backgrounds or pill containers.

vocabulary_mapping.after: Il foglio è bianco. Inizia una nuova attività.

ux_explanation: The redesign shifts the cognitive model from 'Data Entry' to 'Story Reading'. In traditional CRMs, the user scans columns (Type, Status, Date, Name). Here, the user reads a narrative. By removing chips and badges, we reduce visual noise. White space and typographic contrast (Serif vs Sans) do the heavy lifting of information architecture. The 'Da completare' section acts as an urgent, hero-style editorial to-do list, entirely segregated from the historical feed. The timeline groups events by day as continuous text, mimicking a logbook rather than an IT audit trail.

empty_states.da_completare: Nessuna attività in sospeso. Ottimo lavoro.
empty_states.storico: Nessuna attività passata. Inizia a costruire le tue relazioni.

components.filters: Discreet text-based interaction. A minimal input line (border-b only) 'Cerca o affina vista...' or a text button 'Filtri +' that opens the existing ContactDrawer. No permanent dropdowns on the screen.
components.da_completare_section: Hero-style block. Pure white background, bold Playfair heading. Items are listed with their deadline. Minimal UI, looks like a typed list.
components.activity_feed_item: A narrative block. No card background (just rests on white). Separated by 1px stone-200 bottom border. Name is massive (Serif). Content flows organically.
components.timeline_day_group: Left column: Sticky Date (text-xs uppercase stone-400). Right column: Stacked text lines of events. No dots or connecting lines, alignment implies sequence.

wireframes.mobile_activity_feed: Mobile follows the same narrative structure. 390px viewport means padding is reduced to p-4 or p-6. Typography scales down (H1 text-xl), but the sequence remains: Name -> Topic -> Outcome -> Next Step -> Date. No horizontal scrolling, no tables.

interactions.hover_states: Items in 'Da completare' show a 'Rispondi / Segna completata' text link in stone-900 on hover. No heavy background color changes.
interactions.click_details: Clicking an activity row opens the existing 'ContactDrawer.jsx' on the right side for full editing, keeping the reading view clean.
interactions.lazy_loading: Use infinite scroll with a discreet 'Caricamento...' text instead of traditional spinning loaders or heavy pagination controls.

instructions_to_main_agent: Create standard .js React components. Use Shadcn primitives if needed but strip ALL rounded corners (use rounded-none).
Ensure Playfair Display and Montserrat are loaded in the HTML or via CSS imports.
Use standard Tailwind classes. For fonts: font-serif for Playfair, font-sans for Montserrat.
Ensure responsive design: Mobile (390px) completely abandons any tabular approach.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='activity-item-mario-rossi', data-testid='filter-drawer-trigger').
DO NOT use traditional CRM chips/badges for statuses. Map them to readable text ('Esito: ...').
DO NOT modify the WorkspaceShell.jsx. These components will render inside the <main>.
